items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My professor, Dr. Milton Marx, wrote the textbook that was used in all the universities in the United States – Harvard, Yale, Dartmouth, Princeton.

ctx.x: So tell me this. That being the case, how did you feel when you were in San Francisco as a music critic or art critic for the San Francisco Chronicle?

For The Chronicle. I felt at last I have a chance to bring to the criticism of art the attitude of a practicing artist. So I also brought to it the writing talent of a person who got the only A in my creative writing class in seven years. My professor, Dr. Milton Marx, wrote the textbook that was used in all the universities in the United States – Harvard, Yale, Dartmouth, Princeton. This was not an obscure man.
